description: This source file defines an interface for handling the visual appearance of annotations in PDF documents within the PdfSharp library. It includes a single method for rendering the annotation appearance using a graphics context.

classes.name: IAnnotationAppearanceHandler
classes.description: Interface for drawing the visual representation of an annotation or form element in a PDF document.

methods.name: DrawAppearance
methods.description: Draws the visual appearance of an annotation using the provided graphics context and bounding rectangle.
